retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant yellow mid-century record cover featuring a central circular portrait surrounded by twelve radial track bubbles arranged like a clock face.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a saturated yellow background. A central circular cutout contains a duotone portrait of a smiling man. Surrounding this center are twelve smaller white circular 'bubbles' arranged in a perfect clock-face formation, each containing a number and text. Bold, condensed black sans-serif typography spans the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial symmetry between the central portrait and the surrounding track bubbles
High contrast between the black display type and the bright yellow field
Hierarchical dominance of the top header over the central graphic
Repetitive geometric rhythm of the twelve circular track indicators

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large circular portrait occupies the center-middle, roughly 50% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, black condensed text at the top edge serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top header, drop to the central portrait, and then rotate clockwise around the twelve track bubbles.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample yellow space between the central circle and the outer track bubbles maintains clarity.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value contrast in the white bubbles and low value contrast in the black text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to yellow, black, and cream/white

characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers are centered within circular containers
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed display face paired with a standard-width geometric sans for track details.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed verticality of the main header.
Provides the mid-century industrial feel for the track titles.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square image with a solid saturated yellow background. In the center, place a large circular duotone portrait of a man in black and cream. Surround this central circle with twelve smaller cream-colored circles arranged in a clock-face pattern.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, black, extra-condensed sans-serif text across the top. Inside each of the twelve small circles, add a number and a short title in a black geometric sans-serif font, centered.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent, bright yellow?
Are there exactly twelve small circles in a radial pattern?
Is the top text condensed and black?
Is the central portrait contained within a perfect circle?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles

mustAchieve: Clean geometric alignment of the radial circles

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the radial circles are equidistant from the center.
Verify the top header does not touch the edges of the frame.
Check that the duotone portrait uses the same cream color as the bubbles.
Confirm all text is solid black without effects.
recipe.reuseFormula: Saturated yellow field + central circular duotone portrait + 12-point radial tracklist bubbles + condensed sans-serif header.
